description: Update a single zone setting (e.g. set ssl=full, always_use_https=on). Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

setting.description: Setting id to change, e.g. ssl, always_use_https, min_tls_version.

value.description: New value. Type depends on the setting (e.g. ssl='full', always_use_https='on', min_tls_version='1.2').

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: update_zone_setting
